```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6.5, dpi = 200)

pkgs <- c("tidyverse", "nflreadr", "rvest", "chromote", "jsonlite", "gt", "scales")
new  <- pkgs[!pkgs %in% rownames(installed.packages())]
if (length(new)) install.packages(new)

library(tidyverse)
library(nflreadr)
library(rvest)
library(chromote)
library(jsonlite)
library(gt)

# ======================= PARAMETERS =======================
VIP_URL    <- "https://fantasy.vip/nfl/dfs/milly-maker-almanac"
SEASON     <- 2026
CACHE_FILE <- "fantasyvip_player_data.rds"   # delete to force a fresh pull

# Optional manual fallback: if the site offers a CSV export on the
# "Player Data" tab, save it here and it will be used instead of scraping.
MANUAL_CSV <- "fantasyvip_player_data.csv"

POSITIONS  <- c("RB", "WR", "TE")
MIN_SAMPLE <- 40
CREDIT     <- "@rohinmishra / rohinm.substack.com"
# ==========================================================
```

```{r fantasyvip-scraper}
# The Milly Maker Almanac is built from the DraftKings Milly Maker, which is
# always the Sunday MAIN slate - so non-main-slate players are excluded by design.
#
# The page is JavaScript-rendered. This chunk opens it in headless Chrome,
# listens to the network traffic for the JSON the page loads, clicks the
# "Player Data" tab, and keeps any JSON payload that looks like player-week rows
# (has salary + points). If no JSON is captured, it falls back to reading the
# rendered table.

find_player_rows <- function(x) {
  # Recursively search a parsed JSON object for a data frame with salary + points
  if (is.data.frame(x)) {
    nm <- tolower(names(x))
    if (any(str_detect(nm, "salary")) && any(str_detect(nm, "point|fpts|score|dk"))) return(list(x))
    return(flatten(map(x, find_player_rows)))
  }
  if (is.list(x)) return(flatten(map(x, find_player_rows)))
  list()
}

scrape_fantasyvip <- function(url) {
  b <- ChromoteSession$new()
  on.exit(b$close(), add = TRUE)

  captured <- list()
  b$Network$enable()
  b$Network$responseReceived(callback = function(msg) {
    if (str_detect(msg$response$mimeType %||% "", "json")) {
      body <- tryCatch(b$Network$getResponseBody(requestId = msg$requestId),
                       error = function(e) NULL)
      if (!is.null(body$body)) captured[[length(captured) + 1]] <<- body$body
    }
  }, wait_ = FALSE)

  b$Page$navigate(url); b$Page$loadEventFired(); Sys.sleep(4)

  # Make sure the full season is selected, then open the Player Data tab
  b$Runtime$evaluate("
    const clickText = t => { const el = [...document.querySelectorAll('button,a,[role=tab],li,span')]
      .find(e => e.textContent.trim() === t); if (el) el.click(); };
    clickText('Full Season'); clickText('Player Data');")
  Sys.sleep(5)

  # Scroll / expand to trigger any lazy loading
  b$Runtime$evaluate("window.scrollTo(0, document.body.scrollHeight);")
  Sys.sleep(3)

  # 1) Prefer captured JSON
  rows <- captured %>%
    map(~ tryCatch(fromJSON(.x, flatten = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)) %>%
    compact() %>%
    map(find_player_rows) %>%
    flatten()

  if (length(rows)) {
    out <- rows[[which.max(map_int(rows, nrow))]] %>% as_tibble()
    attr(out, "source") <- "json"
    return(out)
  }

  # 2) Fallback: rendered HTML table(s)
  html <- b$Runtime$evaluate("document.documentElement.outerHTML")$result$value
  tbls <- read_html(html) %>% html_elements("table") %>% html_table(fill = TRUE)
  tbls <- keep(tbls, ~ any(str_detect(tolower(names(.x)), "salary")))
  if (!length(tbls)) stop("No player table or JSON found - see notes in the report.")
  out <- bind_rows(tbls) %>% as_tibble()
  attr(out, "source") <- "html"
  out
}

raw <- if (file.exists(MANUAL_CSV)) {
  read_csv(MANUAL_CSV, show_col_types = FALSE)
} else if (file.exists(CACHE_FILE)) {
  readRDS(CACHE_FILE)
} else {
  r <- scrape_fantasyvip(VIP_URL); saveRDS(r, CACHE_FILE); r
}

# Peek at what came back so column mapping can be checked
glimpse(raw)
```

```{r standardize}
# Map whatever column names the site uses onto a standard set.
pick <- function(df, patterns) {
  nm <- names(df)
  hit <- nm[str_detect(tolower(nm), regex(patterns, ignore_case = TRUE))]
  if (length(hit)) df[[hit[1]]] else NA
}

vip <- tibble(
  name      = pick(raw, "^(player|name|player_?name|full_?name|display)"),
  position  = pick(raw, "^(pos|position)"),
  team      = pick(raw, "^(team|tm|team_?abbr)"),
  week      = pick(raw, "^(week|wk)$"),
  salary    = pick(raw, "salary"),
  dk_points = pick(raw, "^(dk_?)?(points|pts|fpts|score|fantasy_?points)$"),
  own       = pick(raw, "own")
) %>%
  mutate(
    season    = SEASON,
    week      = as.integer(parse_number(as.character(week))),
    salary    = parse_number(as.character(salary)),
    salary    = if_else(salary < 100, salary * 1000, salary),   # "$6.3k" -> 6300
    dk_points = parse_number(as.character(dk_points)),
    own       = parse_number(as.character(own)),
    position  = str_to_upper(position),
    team      = recode(team, JAC = "JAX", LA = "LAR", WSH = "WAS")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(salary), !is.na(week))

# Stop early if the mapping missed something important
missing_cols <- names(which(colSums(!is.na(vip[c("name", "position", "team", "week",
                                                  "salary", "dk_points")])) == 0))
if (length(missing_cols))
  stop("Could not map: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "),
       " - check glimpse(raw) and adjust the patterns in pick().")

vip %>% count(week, name = "players_on_main_slate")
```

```{r stats-lines}
# fantasy.VIP points are actual DraftKings points (bonuses included).
# nflverse yardage is used only to measure how many hits needed a +3 bonus.
ids <- load_rosters_weekly(SEASON) %>%
  filter(game_type == "REG") %>%
  transmute(week, team, gsis_id,
            merge_name = clean_player_names(full_name, lowercase = TRUE)) %>%
  distinct(week, team, merge_name, .keep_all = TRUE)

bon <- load_player_stats(SEASON, summary_level = "week") %>%
  filter(season_type == "REG") %>%
  transmute(week, gsis_id = player_id,
            bonus = 3 * (coalesce(rushing_yards, 0) >= 100) +
                    3 * (coalesce(receiving_yards, 0) >= 100))

lines <- load_schedules(SEASON) %>%
  filter(game_type == "REG") %>%
  clean_homeaway() %>%
  transmute(week, team, opponent,
            venue       = if_else(location == "home", "Home", "Away"),
            total_line,
            team_spread = if_else(location == "home", spread_line, -spread_line),  # + = favored
            implied_tt  = total_line / 2 + team_spread / 2)

df <- vip %>%
  filter(position %in% POSITIONS) %>%
  mutate(merge_name = clean_player_names(name, lowercase = TRUE)) %>%
  left_join(ids,   by = c("week", "team", "merge_name")) %>%
  left_join(bon,   by = c("week", "gsis_id")) %>%
  left_join(lines, by = c("week", "team")) %>%
  mutate(
    dk_points = replace_na(dk_points, 0),          # priced but didn't play = 0
    bonus     = replace_na(bonus, 0),
    multiple  = dk_points / (salary / 1000),
    hit3 = multiple >= 3, hit4 = multiple >= 4, hit5 = multiple >= 5,
    hit3_nobonus = (dk_points - bonus) / (salary / 1000) >= 3,
    hit4_nobonus = (dk_points - bonus) / (salary / 1000) >= 4,
    hit5_nobonus = (dk_points - bonus) / (salary / 1000) >= 5,
    position   = factor(position, levels = POSITIONS),
    sal_tier   = cut(salary, c(0, 3999, 4999, 5999, 6999, 7999, Inf),
                     labels = c("<$4K", "$4-4.9K", "$5-5.9K", "$6-6.9K", "$7-7.9K", "$8K+")),
    total_bin  = cut(total_line, c(-Inf, 40.5, 43.5, 46.5, 49.5, Inf),
                     labels = c("<=40.5", "41-43.5", "44-46.5", "47-49.5", "50+")),
    spread_bin = cut(team_spread, c(-Inf, -7.5, -3.5, -0.5, 0.5, 3.5, 7.5, Inf),
                     labels = c("Dog 8+", "Dog 4-7.5", "Dog 1-3.5", "PK",
                                "Fav 1-3.5", "Fav 4-7.5", "Fav 8+")),
    itt_bin    = cut(implied_tt, c(-Inf, 19, 21.5, 24, 26.5, Inf),
                     labels = c("<19", "19-21.5", "21.5-24", "24-26.5", "26.5+"))
  )

Data_Label <- sprintf("DK Milly Maker (main slate) via fantasy.VIP, %d Wks 1-%d | RB/WR/TE | DK scoring incl. bonuses",
                      SEASON, max(df$week))
```

> Unmatched players still count in every hit-rate (salary and DK points come straight from fantasy.VIP); they only lose the "needed a bonus" breakdown.

```{r helpers}
wilson <- function(h, n) {
  p <- h / n; z <- 1.96
  tibble(lo = (p + z^2/(2*n) - z*sqrt(p*(1-p)/n + z^2/(4*n^2))) / (1 + z^2/n),
         hi = (p + z^2/(2*n) + z*sqrt(p*(1-p)/n + z^2/(4*n^2))) / (1 + z^2/n))
}

hit_rates <- function(data, var) {
  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[var]])) %>%
    pivot_longer(c(hit3, hit4, hit5), names_to = "target", values_to = "hit") %>%
    mutate(target = recode(target, hit3 = "3x", hit4 = "4x", hit5 = "5x")) %>%
    group_by(position, target, level = .data[[var]]) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), hits = sum(hit), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(rate = hits / n, bind_cols(wilson(hits, n))) %>%
    group_by(position, target) %>%
    mutate(base = sum(hits) / sum(n), lift = rate / base) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(n >= MIN_SAMPLE)
}

plot_hits <- function(r, xlab, title) {
  ggplot(r, aes(level, rate, colour = target, group = target)) +
    geom_hline(aes(yintercept = base, colour = target), linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), position = position_dodge(0.5), size = 0.3) +
    geom_line(position = position_dodge(0.5), alpha = 0.5) +
    facet_wrap(~ position, nrow = 1) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("3x" = "#2171b5", "4x" = "#238b45", "5x" = "#d7301f")) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = "Hit rate", colour = NULL, title = title,
         subtitle = paste0(Data_Label, "\ndashed = position baseline | 95% CI"),
         caption = paste("Data: fantasy.VIP, nflreadr |", CREDIT)) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8.5, hjust = 0.5),
          legend.position = "top",
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8))
}
```

## Independent effects (salary held constant)

```{r model}
fit_one <- function(d, outcome) {
  d <- filter(d, !is.na(total_line))
  m <- glm(reformulate(c("I(salary/1000)", "I(venue == 'Home')", "total_line", "team_spread"),
                       response = outcome), data = d, family = binomial)
  ci <- suppressMessages(confint.default(m))
  tibble(term = c("Salary (+$1K)", "Home (vs away)", "Game total (+1 pt)", "Spread (+1 pt favored)"),
         odds_ratio = exp(coef(m))[-1], lo = exp(ci[-1, 1]), hi = exp(ci[-1, 2]),
         p = summary(m)$coefficients[-1, 4])
}

expand_grid(position = POSITIONS, target = c("hit3", "hit4", "hit5")) %>%
  mutate(res = map2(position, target,
                    possibly(~ fit_one(filter(df, position == .x), .y), otherwise = NULL))) %>%
  unnest(res) %>%
  mutate(target = recode(target, hit3 = "3x", hit4 = "4x", hit5 = "5x")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(odds_ratio, fct_rev(term), colour = target)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi), position = position_dodge(0.6), size = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~ position, nrow = 1) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("3x" = "#2171b5", "4x" = "#238b45", "5x" = "#d7301f")) +
  labs(x = "Odds ratio (log scale; > 1 = more likely to hit)", y = NULL, colour = NULL,
       title = "Independent Effect of Each Condition", subtitle = Data_Label,
       caption = paste("Data: fantasy.VIP, nflreadr |", CREDIT)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8.5, hjust = 0.5), legend.position = "top")
```

# Ownership & Leverage

```{r own-prep}
# Ownership from fantasy.VIP = actual Milly Maker field ownership (%).
# Leverage framework:
#   implied_rate = how often the field "expects" a hit (ownership share within position-week)
#   own_share    = player's ownership / sum of ownership at his position that week
#   hit_share    = player's share of that week's 5x hits at his position
#   leverage     = actual hit rate - field-implied rate (by bucket)
own_df <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(own)) %>%
  mutate(
    own = if_else(max(own, na.rm = TRUE) <= 1, own * 100, own),   # normalise to %
    own_tier = cut(own, c(-Inf, 2, 5, 10, 20, 30, Inf),
                   labels = c("<2%", "2-5%", "5-10%", "10-20%", "20-30%", "30%+"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(week, position) %>%
  mutate(
    own_share  = own / sum(own),
    own_rank   = min_rank(desc(own)),
    hits5_wk   = sum(hit5),
    hit_share5 = if_else(hits5_wk > 0, hit5 / hits5_wk, NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

stopifnot("No ownership column mapped - check pick(raw, 'own')" = nrow(own_df) > 0)
```

## Hit rate vs. ownership tier

```{r own-tier}
r_own <- hit_rates(own_df, "own_tier")
plot_hits(r_own, "Milly Maker ownership", "Hit Rate by Ownership Tier")
```

> If low-owned tiers hit at rates close to the chalk tiers, the field is over-concentrating on a few players.

## Does ownership track hit probability? (calibration)

```{r calibration}
# Model each player's 5x probability from salary + Vegas (no ownership), then
# compare to how the field actually owned them. Players the model likes but the
# field doesn't = structural leverage.
m5 <- glm(hit5 ~ position * (I(salary/1000) + total_line + team_spread) + venue,
          data = filter(own_df, !is.na(total_line)), family = binomial)

own_df <- own_df %>%
  mutate(p5 = predict(m5, newdata = own_df, type = "response")) %>%
  group_by(week, position) %>%
  mutate(p5_share = p5 / sum(p5, na.rm = TRUE),          # model's share of expected 5x hits
         lev_score = p5_share - own_share) %>%             # + = underowned vs. hit odds
  ungroup()

own_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(p5)) %>%
  mutate(p5_bin = cut(p5, quantile(p5, 0:10/10, na.rm = TRUE), include.lowest = TRUE)) %>%
  group_by(position, p5_bin) %>%
  summarise(model_p5 = mean(p5), actual_5x = mean(hit5), avg_own = mean(own),
            n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(model_p5, avg_own)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n, colour = actual_5x)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ position, nrow = 1, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_colour_gradient(low = "grey80", high = "#d7301f", labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(x = "Model 5x probability (salary + Vegas)", y = "Avg Milly Maker ownership (%)",
       colour = "Actual 5x rate", size = "n",
       title = "Field Ownership vs. Pre-Game 5x Probability",
       subtitle = paste0(Data_Label, "\nflat slope = field under-reacts to hit odds; steep = over-reacts"),
       caption = paste("Data: fantasy.VIP, nflreadr |", CREDIT)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8.5, hjust = 0.5))
```

> The model is fit and evaluated on the same 10 weeks, so treat it as descriptive, not predictive.

## Where is the field leaving 5x on the table?

```{r leverage-conditions}
# For each condition: share of all 5x hits it produced vs. share of ownership it got.
lev_by <- function(var, label) {
  own_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[var]])) %>%
    group_by(position, level = .data[[var]]) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), hits5 = sum(hit5), own_sum = sum(own), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(position) %>%
    mutate(hit_share = hits5 / sum(hits5),
           own_share = own_sum / sum(own_sum),
           leverage  = hit_share - own_share,          # + = field underweights
           lev_ratio = hit_share / own_share) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(factor = label)
}

lev_all <- bind_rows(
  lev_by("venue", "Venue"), lev_by("total_bin", "Game total"),
  lev_by("spread_bin", "Spread"), lev_by("itt_bin", "Implied team total"),
  lev_by("sal_tier", "Salary"), lev_by("own_tier", "Ownership tier")
) %>% filter(n >= MIN_SAMPLE / 2)

ggplot(lev_all, aes(leverage, fct_reorder(paste(factor, level, sep = ": "), leverage),
                    fill = leverage > 0)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey40") +
  facet_wrap(~ position, nrow = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#1b7837", `FALSE` = "#b2182b"), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Share of 5x hits minus share of ownership", y = NULL,
       title = "Leverage by Game Condition",
       subtitle = paste0(Data_Label, "\ngreen = produced more 5x hits than the field owned it for"),
       caption = paste("Data: fantasy.VIP, nflreadr |", CREDIT)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8.5, hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7))
```

## Ownership-weighted points vs. actual (where the field's exposure went)

```{r field-exposure}
own_df %>%
  group_by(position) %>%
  summarise(
    `Field avg mult (own-weighted)` = weighted.mean(multiple, own),
    `Slate avg mult (unweighted)`   = mean(multiple),
    `Chalk (20%+) 5x rate`          = mean(hit5[own >= 20]),
    `Sub-5% 5x rate`                = mean(hit5[own < 5]),
    `5x hits from sub-5% players`   = sum(hit5 & own < 5) / pmax(sum(hit5), 1),
    `Avg own of 5x hits`            = mean(own[hit5]),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header("Where the field's exposure went", Data_Label) %>%
  fmt_number(contains("mult"), decimals = 2) %>%
  fmt_percent(c(contains("rate"), contains("from")), decimals = 1) %>%
  fmt_number(`Avg own of 5x hits`, decimals = 1, pattern = "{x}%")
```

## Chalk busts vs. low-owned smashes

```{r chalk-vs-contrarian}
own_df %>%
  mutate(group = case_when(own >= 20 & multiple < 2 ~ "Chalk bust (20%+, <2x)",
                           own >= 20 & hit4       ~ "Chalk hit (20%+, 4x+)",
                           own < 5   & hit5       ~ "Contrarian smash (<5%, 5x+)",
                           TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(group)) %>%
  group_by(group, position) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            avg_salary = mean(salary), avg_total = mean(total_line, na.rm = TRUE),
            avg_spread = mean(team_spread, na.rm = TRUE),
            avg_itt = mean(implied_tt, na.rm = TRUE),
            home_pct = mean(venue == "Home", na.rm = TRUE),
            bonus_pct = mean(bonus > 0),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "group") %>%
  tab_header("Profile: chalk busts vs. contrarian smashes", Data_Label) %>%
  fmt_currency(avg_salary, decimals = 0) %>%
  fmt_number(c(avg_total, avg_spread, avg_itt), decimals = 1) %>%
  fmt_percent(c(home_pct, bonus_pct), decimals = 0)
```

## Biggest leverage plays of the season

```{r top-leverage}
own_df %>%
  filter(hit4) %>%
  mutate(lev_points = dk_points * (1 - own / 100)) %>%   # points the field mostly missed
  arrange(desc(lev_points)) %>%
  transmute(Wk = week, Player = name, Pos = position, Team = team,
            Salary = salary, `Own %` = own, `DK Pts` = dk_points,
            Mult = round(multiple, 2), `Model 5x %` = p5,
            Total = total_line, Spread = team_spread, ITT = round(implied_tt, 1)) %>%
  head(30) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header("Top leverage hits (4x+ ranked by points x unowned share)", Data_Label) %>%
  fmt_currency(Salary, decimals = 0) %>%
  fmt_number(`Own %`, decimals = 1) %>%
  fmt_percent(`Model 5x %`, decimals = 0)
```

## Recurring underowned profiles (repeatable patterns)

```{r underowned-profiles}
# Players the model rated as live (top-third p5 at position-week) but the field
# rostered under 8%: how often did they pay off?
own_df %>%
  group_by(week, position) %>%
  mutate(p5_rank_pct = percent_rank(p5)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(profile = case_when(p5_rank_pct >= 2/3 & own < 8  ~ "Live & underowned",
                             p5_rank_pct >= 2/3 & own >= 8 ~ "Live & popular",
                             TRUE ~ "Other")) %>%
  group_by(position, profile) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), avg_own = mean(own), `3x` = mean(hit3), `4x` = mean(hit4),
            `5x` = mean(hit5), avg_mult = mean(multiple), .groups = "drop") %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "position") %>%
  tab_header("Model-favored players: underowned vs. popular", Data_Label) %>%
  fmt_number(c(avg_own, avg_mult), decimals = 1) %>%
  fmt_percent(c(`3x`, `4x`, `5x`), decimals = 1)

# Which teams/conditions produced underowned 4x+ games repeatedly
own_df %>%
  filter(hit4, own < 8) %>%
  count(team, position, name = "underowned_4x_games", sort = TRUE) %>%
  filter(underowned_4x_games >= 2) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header("Teams producing repeated underowned 4x+ games", "own < 8%")
```
